role.title: ComputeEngineBasics-Candidate
role.description: Least-privilege role for the Compute Engine Basics candidate workflow: inspect the lab network and Ubuntu image, create and start ubuntu-vm, and allow metadata-based gcloud compute ssh key propagation. Permission names are grounded in the Google Cloud Compute Engine IAM permissions reference (https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/access/iam) and gcloud compute ssh documentation (https://cloud.google.com/sdk/gcloud/reference/compute/ssh). No project administration, IAM, or Resource Manager permissions are included.
